hunt.name: Penkala's pen
hunt.line: Good job finding my pen! I'm Slavoljub Penkala.
hunt.fact: In Zagreb in 1906 I patented the mechanical pencil, and a year later a fountain pen with solid ink.

hunt.name: The necktie (kravata)
hunt.fact: In the 1600s Croatian soldiers in France wore knotted neck scarves. The French called them 'cravates', after the Croats.

hunt.name: Vrancic's parachute
hunt.line: Good job finding my parachute! I'm Faust Vrancic from Sibenik.
hunt.fact: In my book Machinae Novae (around 1615) I drew 'Homo Volans', a flying man under a square sail: an early parachute.

hunt.name: The Rijeka torpedo
hunt.line: Good job finding my torpedo! I'm Ivan Lupis from Rijeka.
hunt.fact: Together with Robert Whitehead I built the first self-propelled torpedo in Rijeka in 1866.
